summary.text: Says Henry supports working people, publicly-funded education, workplace safety, campaign finance reform, and the environment.
summary.quote: I support working people, publicly-funded education from pre-K to trade guilds and higher education, strong workplace safety, real campaign finance reform, and protecting the environment and climate.

summary.text: Says Henry wants to cut military spending and end wars.
summary.quote:
CUT MASSIVE U.$. MILITARY
End Pointless Wars.
